implementation: AionExecutionPlan binds immutable host policy, legal stages, finite costs, finite budget and zero-cost STOP. AionExecutionDecision is treated as an immutable untrusted selection. HostActionRegistry snapshots the only callbacks. The executor returns STOP without invoking a callback for forced, explicit, illegal, unaffordable or unregistered requests. Traces bind plan, full-decision and registered-action-set SHA-256 identities; offline verification rederives enforcement without invoking any callback. AionExecutionLedger binds a complete requested decision sequence, carries budget continuously, records consumed requests and makes STOP terminal across the chain.
